## Wallpaper that reflects the world around you

Drift is a living wallpaper for Mac. It paints slow, moving gradients on your desktop that shift with the time of day and your local weather: warm light at sunset, rain, snow and storms when they arrive. Start with one of our nine beautiful palettes or generate your own. Turn on Real Sky to match the light and weather conditions outside your window. It runs as your real wallpaper on every display, and as your screen saver too. Free for 14 days. Launch price $12/year until December 18, then $15.
